sv.title: Brittisk utredning om billiga kinesiska robotgräsklippare
sv.summary: Trädgårdsbolaget Husqvarna har anmält import av billiga kinesiska robotgräsklippare till den brittiska handelsmyndigheten Trade Remedies Authority (TRA), som inlett en antidumpningsutredning.

en.title: British investigation into cheap Chinese robotic lawn mowers
en.summary: Garden company Husqvarna has reported imports of cheap Chinese robotic lawn mowers to the British trade authority Trade Remedies Authority (TRA), which has launched an anti-dumping investigation.
